inputs.text:
Folks, we are watching a direct assault on the backbone of this nation—our hardworking business owners and productive citizens. The owner of Blue Waters had the courage to call out an overreaching government that simply collects taxes "without doing or investing in anything." That is the undeniable truth about a bloated bureaucracy that feeds off the people who actually build this country while giving nothing back.

And how does the progressive establishment respond? By scheming to slap yet another tax on our people, declaring that "Perhaps this might be considered as an environmental tax." They never stop. It is a constant shakedown of the productive class, all under the false, utopian banner of saving the planet just to fund their endless control-freak schemes. 

Instead of backing local enterprise, personal responsibility, and the traditional values that keep our communities strong and orderly, what do these institutions obsess over? They whine that "Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter..." Instead of restoring basic civic pride and personal accountability, they just want to tax us more to cover up the cultural decay they themselves created. It is past time to stand up for social order, authority, and the people who actually keep this nation running.
